//: Step 03. Type-checks everything the per-package `tsc -b` builds deliberately do NOT cover: unit/integration tests, every vitest*.config.ts, the shared vitest.shared.ts, and the integration harness (test/**). Run via `pnpm run typecheck:tests`; `pnpm run typecheck:all` runs it together with the per-package source typecheck. noEmit only -- nothing here is ever built into dist/. Uses Bundler module resolution (not the base's NodeNext) because Vitest/Vite, not Node, loads the test files themselves. The vitest*.config.ts files import `../../vitest.shared.ts` WITH its extension so they also load under Vite's `configLoader: native` (plain Node ESM, which needs exact file names); `allowImportingTsExtensions` makes that legal here and is only allowed because this config is noEmit. `types` is explicit because TypeScript 6 no longer auto-includes @types/* packages.
